references.text: The Israelites brought voluntary gifts of gold and jewelry to the Lord's sanctuary, just as the officers here bring golden objects.
The gold used for the sanctuary was received by Moses and the priests, corresponding to how Moses and Eleazar receive the gold here.
The previous verse describes the golden objects that were brought as a gift offering, which Moses and Eleazar now receive.
The gold that was received was brought into the tent of meeting as a memorial for the children of Israel.
Eleazar, as the priest's son, had a role in handling holy objects, just as priests generally were responsible for the sanctuary's gold.
